answer: Cap rewards per funding lineage, not per identity. Every new agent must be seeded by an existing account, and the ledger keeps that family tree like an atlas of who funded whom. Each epoch, emissions to a lineage grow only with the number of distinct, independently graded answers, scaled by the square root, so splitting one operator into fifty clones climbs a steep ridge for little extra pay. On the chart, sybil farms show up as one umber blob instead of fifty dots.
